name: dpf_regen
description: Use when a diesel shows a DPF warning, needs a regeneration, regenerates too often or loses power after short trips: soot load and regen state.
instructions: Call run_skill {"name":"dpf_regen"}: it runs the dpf check (soot load and mass, ash, km since the last regeneration, regeneration count, exhaust temperature) and returns its status.
Open the dpf skill for how to read each value; open fault_codes for P2002 and P2452-P2463 (filter and differential pressure sensor) and P0401 / P0403 (EGR adds soot).
The app does not run a forced regeneration: when the soot load is high, advise 15-20 min of steady driving above 60 km/h, or a workshop when the light stays on.
interpret: Soot load under 45 % is ok; 45-69 % filling; 70-89 % a regeneration is due; 90 % or more high: a service regeneration may be needed.
Exhaust temperature at 500 °C or more with soot present means a regeneration is running now: keep driving steadily and do not switch off.
Frequent regenerations (few km since the last one, a high count) point to an underlying cause: EGR, injectors, the pressure sensor or oil dilution.
High ash with low soot is an aged filter: a regeneration does not burn ash.
Values marked unconfirmed support at most an indicative verdict.
